description: Events from the Brightspace course calendar: exams, tests, labs, classes, office hours and other dated events that instructors post, plus due-date events. Use this when the user asks when an exam or test is, what is on their schedule, or what is happening on a day. For what work is left to hand in, use get_todo instead.

daysAhead.description: How many days ahead to include

daysBack.description: Also include events from this many days ago

search.description: Only events whose title or description contains this text, for example 'exam' or 'midterm'

name: get_calendar_events
title: Get Calendar Events
